normal_schedule.contract: After valid count>=2, high=base+(count-1)*width. For each inclusive subrange, derive unsigned ((high-low)/width)+1. At most8 elements take shortsort; larger ranges enter median partition. No sorted-input early exit.

mid=low+floor(subrange_count/2)*width. Always compare(low,mid), compare(low,high), compare(mid,high), in that exact order; swap each pair only for signed result>0. The pivot is the live mid address, not a copied value. Actual callback call sites are44B/466/481; actual median swap calls45F/47A/495.

Low scan advances before each comparison. First loop handles addresses below pivot; reaching pivot skips its self-comparison and enters the second incrementing loop. Second loop checks high before comparing. Continue on signed compare(scan,pivot)<=0; stop on>0 or one-past-high. Retain both distinct callback sites4AC/4CA.
High scan decrements before comparison. Stop at or below pivot without callback; above pivot, continue only on signed compare(scan,pivot)>0. Callback site4E0; no sign normalization.

If unsigned low_scan<=high_scan, exchange their bytes unless addresses equal. When high_scan equals the live pivot, rebind pivot to low_scan, including the equal-address no-exchange case. Repeat from retained scan positions; never restart at original endpoints.

After scans cross, add width to high_scan once. Upper equality loop predecrements and compares only above pivot, continuing exactly on result==0. Skip the pivot, then lower equality loop predecrements and compares only strictly above original low, continuing on==0. Stop at low without comparing it. Retain distinct callback sites548/56C and live pivot pointer.

Compare signed byte distances (high_scan-original_low) versus (original_high-low_scan). If left is strictly smaller, push valid right and process valid left immediately; otherwise push valid left and process valid right. Equal distances push left and process right. A remaining partition is valid only when low<high (at least2 elements).

When an immediate partition is absent or shortsort completes, decrement the signed stack count. Negative finishes; otherwise pop matching low/high endpoints from the two30-entry arrays at native frame offsets20/98 and resume at the subrange-size decision. LIFO order is mandatory; no recursion or heap worklist.

Shortsort returns if unsigned high<=low. Otherwise repeatedly initialize max=low, scan low+width through current high in ascending addresses, compare(scan,max) and replace max only for signed result>0. Exchange max with high if distinct, then high-=width. Its only callback site is2F2. For k valid elements, k*(k-1)/2 callbacks occur on normal returns.

arithmetic_and_control_hazards.signedness: Count threshold/cutoff, pointer relations, division and index endpoints use unsigned interpretation. Comparator signs use signed int32. arithmetic_and_control_hazards.safe_Source_representation: Prefer bounded unsigned element indices/byte offsets for scan and stack state, forming actual_base+offset only for proven reached element/callback addresses. Preserve a one-past low-scan sentinel without dereferencing it. Compute partition distances in a wider signed type then use the proved int32 domain, avoiding unsigned underflow and C++ signed overflow/pointer-difference UB. Integer arithmetic is an implementation choice, not a new native guard.
arithmetic_and_control_hazards.sentinel_bound: With coherent median/pivot invariants, low_scan is at least low+width and at most high+width; high_scan after equality trimming remains at least low and at most high-width. Thus neither scheduled child reproduces its full parent, and no before-base dereference is needed. Do not mechanically manufacture an out-of-allocation pointer merely to reproduce a register subtraction.
arithmetic_and_control_hazards.stack_storage: The native frame reserves0x100 bytes and uses two adjacent30-entry endpoint arrays: offsets20..94 and98..10C after saved registers. Preserve matched endpoint pairs and LIFO order; entries are written before a matching pop.
arithmetic_and_control_hazards.stack_bound_proof: Crossed scans and subsequent downward equality trim produce disjoint children with total element count<=parent count, each strictly smaller. Signed distance selection agrees with child-size selection in the admitted range, so every continued descent after a push processes at most floor(parent/2). Pushes only occur for active ranges of size>=9. A chain of k simultaneous pushes therefore requires initial count>=9*2^(k-1). With count<=2^31-1, k<=28 because9*2^28 exceeds2^31-1. Immediate absent/singleton children pop without further descent. The fixed30 slots therefore suffice with at least2 spare entries. This is a static proof under the stated domain, not an executed stress test.
